verdict: WMI returned `WBEM_E_ACCESS_DENIED`. The calling account (typically SYSTEM for MECM operations) lacks permission on the target namespace. Commonly caused by a hardening baseline overwriting default ACLs on `root\ccm` or `root\cimv2`.
fix: Open `wmimgmt.msc` -> right-click `WMI Control (Local)` -> Properties -> Security tab. On the affected namespace, confirm `NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM` has `Full Control` and `Remote Enable` at `This namespace and subnamespaces`. If ACLs were overwritten (audit: compare to a known-good machine), reapply defaults by recompiling the relevant MOF: `mofcomp $env:windir\system32\wbem\cimwin32.mof` for cimv2; for `root\ccm`, the cleanest restore is a CM client repair: `ccmsetup.exe /forceinstall`.
